question_text: A ticket sale has SaleID and ProductID. Each product may occur only once in a sale, with quantity stored separately. Outline why (SaleID, ProductID) can be a suitable composite primary key.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Neither SaleID nor ProductID is individually unique across all lines.; Their combination uniquely identifies one product line in one sale.; The key enforces the one-line-per-product-per-sale rule without an extra line identifier.
